hookText: He replaced the Mac Dock entirely.

beats.say: John Siracusa spent three and a half months building Jetty Pro, a Mac app that creates customizable Dock-like floating palettes around the edges of your displays.
The palettes can hold files, folders, volumes, apps, Shortcuts, and even the Trash, and the app can simulate Dock backgrounds from macOS 15, 26, and 27.
It costs 9.99 dollars per year as an introductory price until the end of 2026, with a 14-day free trial, after more than 160 builds for 250 beta testers.
